rules.logic: BIOC(NGFW EAL — outbound HTTP carrying X-Simulation-Run-ID header (operator filter)) OR (XQL(NGFW EAL — periodic HTTP beacon (regular interval, anomalous User-Agent)) AND XQL(NGFW EAL — DGA-style URI parameter on outbound HTTP))
rules.name: C2 HTTP Beacon — Periodic Outbound With Anomalous Client
